interpretations: Include films with `rental_duration >= 5`; group by `original_language_id`, with NULL as its own group; return the unrounded average of the group average rental rates and the unrounded average of the group film counts, in that order.

Include films with `rental_duration > 5`; group by `original_language_id`, with NULL as its own group; return the unrounded average of the group average rental rates and the unrounded average of the group film counts, in that order.
queries:
WITH language_groups AS (
  SELECT
    original_language_id,
    AVG(rental_rate) AS avg_rental_rate,
    COUNT(*) AS film_count
  FROM film
  WHERE rental_duration >= 5
  GROUP BY original_language_id
)
SELECT AVG(avg_rental_rate), AVG(film_count)
FROM language_groups

SELECT AVG(avg_rental_rate), AVG(film_count)
FROM (
  SELECT original_language_id,
         AVG(rental_rate) AS avg_rental_rate,
         COUNT(*) AS film_count
  FROM film
  WHERE rental_duration > 5
  GROUP BY original_language_id
)
